1.sahih_international: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
1.pickthall: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another
1.yusuf_ali: By the (Winds) sent forth one after another (to man's profit);
1.shakir: I swear by the emissary winds, sent one after another (for men's benefit),
1.muhammad_sarwar: By (the angels) sent forth with the commands of God,
1.mohsin_khan: By the winds (or angels or the Messengers of Allah) sent forth one after another.

2.sahih_international: And the winds that blow violently
2.yusuf_ali: Which then blow violently in tempestuous Gusts,
2.muhammad_sarwar: by (the angels) as swift as blowing winds,
2.mohsin_khan: And by the winds that blow violently,

3.pickthall: By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive;
3.shakir: Which scatter clouds to their destined places,
3.muhammad_sarwar: by (the angels) spreading (the words of God) far and wide,
3.mohsin_khan: And by the winds that scatter clouds and rain;

4.pickthall: By those who winnow with a winnowing,
4.yusuf_ali: Then separate them, one from another,
4.shakir: Then separate them one from another,
4.muhammad_sarwar: by (the angels) who make a clear distinction between right and wrong
4.mohsin_khan: And by the Verses (of the Quran) that separate the right from the wrong.

5.sahih_international: And those [angels] who deliver a message
5.pickthall: By those who bring down the Reminder,
5.shakir: Then I swear by the angels who bring down the revelation,
5.muhammad_sarwar: and by those who reveal revelations (to the prophets)
5.mohsin_khan: And by the angels that bring the revelations to the Messengers,

6.yusuf_ali: Whether of Justification or of Warning;-
6.muhammad_sarwar: to provide excuses for some and to give warnings to others:
6.mohsin_khan: To cut off all excuses or to warn;

7.sahih_international: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
7.pickthall: Surely that which ye are promised will befall.
7.yusuf_ali: Assuredly, what ye are promised must come to pass.
7.shakir: Most surely what you are threatened with must come to pass.
7.muhammad_sarwar: that whatever with which you have been warned will inevitably come to pass.
7.mohsin_khan: Surely, what you are promised must come to pass.
7.arberry: surely that which you are promised is about to fall!

8.sahih_international: So when the stars are obliterated
8.pickthall: So when the stars are put out,
8.yusuf_ali: Then when the stars become dim;
8.shakir: So when the stars are made to lose their light,
8.muhammad_sarwar: Then the stars will lose their light.
8.mohsin_khan: Then when the stars lose their lights;
8.arberry: When the stars shall be extinguished,

9.sahih_international: And when the heaven is opened
9.pickthall: And when the sky is riven asunder,
9.yusuf_ali: When the heaven is cleft asunder;
9.shakir: And when the heaven is rent asunder,
9.mohsin_khan: And when the heaven is cleft asunder;

10.sahih_international: And when the mountains are blown away
10.pickthall: And when the mountains are blown away,
10.yusuf_ali: When the mountains are scattered (to the winds) as dust;
10.shakir: And when the mountains are carried away as dust,
10.muhammad_sarwar: The mountains will be blown away as dust.
10.mohsin_khan: And when the mountains are blown away;
10.arberry: when the mountains shall be scattered

11.sahih_international: And when the messengers' time has come...
11.pickthall: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed -
11.yusuf_ali: And when the messengers are (all) appointed a time (to collect);-
11.shakir: And when the apostles are gathered at their appointed time
11.muhammad_sarwar: The Messengers will receive their appointments.
11.mohsin_khan: And when the Messengers are gathered to their time appointed;
11.arberry: and when the Messengers' time is set,

12.sahih_international: For what Day was it postponed?
12.pickthall: For what day is the time appointed?
12.yusuf_ali: For what Day are these (portents) deferred?
12.shakir: To what day is the doom fixed?
12.muhammad_sarwar: If one asks, "To which day have such calamitous events been postponed?"
12.mohsin_khan: For what Day are these signs postponed?
12.arberry: to what day shall they be delayed?

13.yusuf_ali: For the Day of Sorting out.
13.muhammad_sarwar: one will be told,"To the Day of Distinction".
13.mohsin_khan: For the Day of sorting out (the men of Paradise from the men destined for Hell).

14.sahih_international: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
14.pickthall: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -
14.yusuf_ali: And what will explain to thee what is the Day of Sorting out?
14.shakir: And what will make you comprehend what the day of decision is?
14.muhammad_sarwar: Would that you knew about the Day of Judgment!
14.mohsin_khan: And what will explain to you what is the Day of sorting out?
14.arberry: And what shall teach thee what is the Day of Decision?

15.sahih_international: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
15.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
15.yusuf_ali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
15.shakir: Woe on that day to the rejecters.
15.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, woe will be to those who have rejected God's revelations!
15.mohsin_khan: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
15.arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

16.sahih_international: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
16.pickthall: Destroyed We not the former folk,
16.yusuf_ali: Did We not destroy the men of old (for their evil)?
16.shakir: Did We not destroy the former generations?
16.muhammad_sarwar: Did We not destroy the ancient people
16.mohsin_khan: Did We not destroy the ancients?
16.arberry: Did We not destroy the ancients,

17.sahih_international: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
17.pickthall: Then caused the latter folk to follow after?
17.yusuf_ali: So shall We make later (generations) follow them.
17.shakir: Then did We follow them up with later ones.
17.muhammad_sarwar: and make others settle after them in their land?
17.mohsin_khan: So shall We make later generations to follow them.
17.arberry: and then follow them with the later folk?

18.sahih_international: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
18.pickthall: Thus deal We ever with the guilty.
18.yusuf_ali: Thus do We deal with men of sin.
18.shakir: Even thus shall We deal with the guilty.
18.muhammad_sarwar: Thus do We deal with the sinful ones.
18.mohsin_khan: Thus do We deal with the Mujrimun (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals, etc.)!

19.sahih_international: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
19.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
19.yusuf_ali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
19.shakir: Woe on that day to the rejecters.
19.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, woe upon those who have rejected God's revelations!
19.mohsin_khan: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
19.arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

20.sahih_international: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
20.pickthall: Did We not create you from a base fluid
20.yusuf_ali: Have We not created you from a fluid (held) despicable?-
20.shakir: Did We not create you from contemptible water?
20.muhammad_sarwar: Did We not create you from an insignificant drop of fluid
20.mohsin_khan: Did We not create you from a worthless water (semen, etc.)?
20.arberry: Did We not create you of a mean water,

21.sahih_international: And We placed it in a firm lodging
21.pickthall: Which We laid up in a safe abode
21.yusuf_ali: The which We placed in a place of rest, firmly fixed,
21.shakir: Then We placed it in a secure resting-place,
21.muhammad_sarwar: and place it in a secure place
21.mohsin_khan: Then We placed it in a place of safety (womb),
21.arberry: that We laid within a sure lodging

22.yusuf_ali: For a period (of gestation), determined (according to need)?
22.mohsin_khan: For a known period (determined by gestation)?

23.sahih_international: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
23.pickthall: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!
23.yusuf_ali: For We do determine (according to need); for We are the best to determine (things).
23.shakir: So We proportion it-- how well are We at proportioning (things).
23.muhammad_sarwar: Thus did We Plan and how excellent is Our planning!
23.mohsin_khan: So We did measure, and We are the Best to measure (the things).
23.arberry: We determined; excellent determiners are We.

24.sahih_international: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
24.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
24.yusuf_ali: Ah woe, that Day! to the Rejecters of Truth!
24.shakir: Woe on that day to the rejecters.
24.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, woe would be upon those who have rejected the revelations of God!
24.mohsin_khan: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
24.arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

25.sahih_international: Have We not made the earth a container
25.pickthall: Have We not made the earth a receptacle
25.yusuf_ali: Have We not made the earth (as a place) to draw together.
25.shakir: Have We not made the earth to draw together to itself,
25.muhammad_sarwar: Did We not make the earth as a gathering place
25.mohsin_khan: Have We not made the earth a receptacle?
25.arberry: Made We not the earth to be a housing

26.sahih_international: Of the living and the dead?
26.pickthall: Both for the living and the dead,
26.muhammad_sarwar: for the living and the dead,
26.mohsin_khan: For the living and the dead.
26.arberry: for the living and for the dead?

27.sahih_international: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
27.pickthall: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?
27.yusuf_ali: And made therein mountains standing firm, lofty (in stature); and provided for you water sweet (and wholesome)?
27.shakir: And made therein lofty mountains, and given you to drink of sweet water?
27.muhammad_sarwar: place on it high mountains and provide you with fresh water?
27.mohsin_khan: And have placed therein firm, and tall mountains; and have given you to drink sweet water?
27.arberry: Set We not therein soaring mountains? Sated you with sweetest water?

28.sahih_international: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
28.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
28.yusuf_ali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
28.shakir: Woe on that day to the rejecters.
28.muhammad_sarwar: On that Day (of Judgment) woe would be upon those who have rejected God's revelations!
28.mohsin_khan: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
28.arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

29.sahih_international: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
29.pickthall: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny;
29.yusuf_ali: (It will be said:) "Depart ye to that which ye used to reject as false!
29.shakir: Walk on to that which you called a lie.
29.muhammad_sarwar: Proceed to that (the Day of Judgment) which you have rejected.
29.mohsin_khan: (It will be said to the disbelievers): "Depart you to that which you used to deny!
29.arberry: Depart to that you cried was lies!

30.sahih_international: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
30.pickthall: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold,
30.yusuf_ali: "Depart ye to a Shadow (of smoke ascending) in three columns,
30.shakir: Walk on to the covering having three branches,
30.muhammad_sarwar: Proceed to that shadow, rising in three columns
30.mohsin_khan: "Depart you to a shadow (of Hell-fire smoke ascending) in three columns,

31.sahih_international: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
31.pickthall: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame.
31.yusuf_ali: "(Which yields) no shade of coolness, and is of no use against the fierce Blaze.
31.shakir: Neither having the coolness of the shade nor availing against the flame.
31.muhammad_sarwar: which neither gives shade nor protects one from the flames.
31.mohsin_khan: "Neither shading, nor of any use against the fierce flame of the Fire."

32.sahih_international: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
32.pickthall: Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles,
32.yusuf_ali: "Indeed it throws about sparks (huge) as Forts,
32.shakir: Surely it sends up sparks like palaces,
32.muhammad_sarwar: The fire will shoot out sparks as big as huge towers
32.mohsin_khan: Verily! It (Hell) throws sparks (huge) as Al-Qasr [a fort or a Qasr (huge log of wood)],
32.arberry: that shoots sparks like dry faggots,

33.sahih_international: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
33.pickthall: (Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue.
33.yusuf_ali: "As if there were (a string of) yellow camels (marching swiftly)."
33.shakir: As if they were tawny camels.
33.mohsin_khan: As if they were Jimalatun Sufr (yellow camels or bundles of ropes)."

34.sahih_international: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
34.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
34.yusuf_ali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
34.shakir: Woe on that day to the rejecters.
34.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, woe would be upon those who have rejected God's revelations!
34.mohsin_khan: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
34.arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

35.sahih_international: This is a Day they will not speak,
35.pickthall: This is a day wherein they speak not,
35.yusuf_ali: That will be a Day when they shall not be able to speak.
35.shakir: This is the day on which they shall not speak,
35.muhammad_sarwar: On that day they will not be able to speak,
35.mohsin_khan: That will be a Day when they shall not speak (during some part of it),
35.arberry: This is the day they shall not speak

36.sahih_international: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
36.pickthall: Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses.
36.yusuf_ali: Nor will it be open to them to put forth pleas.
36.shakir: And permission shall not be given to them so that they should offer excuses.
36.muhammad_sarwar: nor will they be permitted to offer any excuses.
36.mohsin_khan: And they will not be permitted to put forth any excuse.
36.arberry: neither be given leave, and excuse themselves.

37.sahih_international: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
37.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
37.yusuf_ali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
37.shakir: Woe on that day to the rejecters.
37.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, woe would be those who have rejected God's revelations!
37.mohsin_khan: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
37.arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

38.sahih_international: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
38.pickthall: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.
38.yusuf_ali: That will be a Day of Sorting out! We shall gather you together and those before (you)!
38.shakir: This is the day of decision: We have gathered you and those of yore.
38.muhammad_sarwar: That is the Day of Judgment. We will bring you together with all the ancient peoples.
38.mohsin_khan: That will be a Day of Decision! We have brought you and the men of old together!
38.arberry: 'This is the Day of Decision; We have joined you with the ancients;

39.sahih_international: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
39.pickthall: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.
39.yusuf_ali: Now, if ye have a trick (or plot), use it against Me!
39.shakir: So if you have a plan, plan against Me (now).
39.muhammad_sarwar: If you have any plans, use them.
39.mohsin_khan: So if you have a plot, use it against Me (Allah)!
39.arberry: if you have a trick, try you now to trick Me!'

40.sahih_international: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
40.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
40.yusuf_ali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
40.shakir: Woe on that day to the rejecters.
40.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, woe would be upon those who have rejected God's revelations!
40.mohsin_khan: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
40.arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

41.sahih_international: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
41.pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains,
41.yusuf_ali: As to the Righteous, they shall be amidst (cool) shades and springs (of water).
41.shakir: Surely those who guard (against evil) shall be amid shades and fountains,
41.muhammad_sarwar: The pious ones will rest amid the shade, springs,
41.mohsin_khan: Verily, the Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2) shall be amidst shades and springs.
41.arberry: Truly the godfearing shall dwell amid shades and fountains,

42.sahih_international: And fruits from whatever they desire,
42.pickthall: And fruits such as they desire.
42.yusuf_ali: And (they shall have) fruits,- all they desire.
42.shakir: And fruits such as they desire.
42.muhammad_sarwar: and fruits of the kind which they desire.
42.mohsin_khan: And fruits, such as they desire.
42.arberry: and such fruits as their hearts desire:

43.sahih_international: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
43.pickthall: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did.
43.yusuf_ali: "Eat ye and drink ye to your heart's content: for that ye worked (Righteousness).
43.shakir: Eat and drink pleasantly because of what you did.
43.muhammad_sarwar: (They will be told), "Eat and drink in good health as a reward for what you have done".
43.mohsin_khan: "Eat and drink comfortably for that which you used to do.
43.arberry: 'Eat and drink, with wholesome appetite, for that you were working.'

44.sahih_international: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
44.pickthall: Thus do We reward the good.
44.yusuf_ali: Thus do We certainly reward the Doers of Good.
44.shakir: Surely thus do We reward the doers of good.
44.muhammad_sarwar: Thus do We reward the righteous ones.
44.mohsin_khan: Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinun (good-doers).
44.arberry: Even so do We recompense the good-doers.

45.sahih_international: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
45.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
45.yusuf_ali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
45.shakir: Woe on that day to the rejecters.
45.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, woe would be upon those who have rejected God's revelations!
45.mohsin_khan: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
45.arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

46.sahih_international: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
46.pickthall: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.
46.yusuf_ali: (O ye unjust!) Eat ye and enjoy yourselves (but) a little while, for that ye are Sinners.
46.shakir: Eat and enjoy yourselves for a little; surely you are guilty.
46.muhammad_sarwar: (Disbelievers), eat and enjoy yourselves for a little while. You are certainly sinful ones.
46.mohsin_khan: (O you disbelievers)! Eat and enjoy yourselves (in this worldly life) for a little while. Verily, you are the Mujrimun (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals, etc.).
46.arberry: 'Eat and take your joy a little; you are sinners!'

47.sahih_international: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
47.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
47.yusuf_ali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
47.shakir: Woe on that day to the rejecters.
47.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, woe would be upon those who have rejected God's revelations!
47.mohsin_khan: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
47.arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

48.sahih_international: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
48.pickthall: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!
48.yusuf_ali: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate yourselves!" they do not so.
48.shakir: And where it is said to them: Bow down, they do not bow down.
48.muhammad_sarwar: When they are told to say their prayers, they do not bow down (in prayer).
48.mohsin_khan: And when it is said to them: "Bow down yourself (in prayer)!" They bow not down (offer not their prayers).
48.arberry: When it is said to them, 'Prostrate yourselves!' they prostrate not.

49.sahih_international: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
49.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
49.yusuf_ali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
49.shakir: Woe on that day to the rejecters.
49.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, woe would be upon those who have rejected God's revelations!
49.mohsin_khan: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
49.arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

50.sahih_international: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?
50.pickthall: In what statement, after this, will they believe?
50.yusuf_ali: Then what Message, after that, will they believe in?
50.shakir: In what announcement, then, after it, will they believe?
50.muhammad_sarwar: In which word other than the Quran will they believe?
50.mohsin_khan: Then in what statement after this (the Quran) will they believe?
50.arberry: In what discourse after this will they believe?
